dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: I'm on my deathbed anyway, what difference does it make? Dragging me to a place like this...

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: He should've just let me freeze to death in my old house. At least there'd be no need to bother with a coffin. The place was good enough for me — not like I've got anyone to leave it to anyway.
